Place \(A=(0,0)\), \(B=(3,0)\), \(C=(3,30)\), and \(D=(-72,30)\). Write \(P=(-72t,30t)\). Since the circumcircle is tangent to \(AD\) at \(P\), its center lies on the line through \(P\) perpendicular to \(AD\). The center also lies on the perpendicular bisector of \(BC\), so it has the form \((u,15)\).

Applying these two conditions and equating the center’s distances from \(P\) and \(B\) gives
\[
4056t^2+338t-19=0.
\]
The root with \(0<t<1\) is \(t=\frac1{26}\). Thus \(P=(-36/13,15/13)\), and
\[
BP=\frac{15\sqrt{26}}{13},\qquad
CP=\frac{75\sqrt{26}}{13}.
\]
Therefore \(CP-BP=\frac{60\sqrt{26}}{13}\), giving \(a+b+c=60+26+13=99\).
